infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Earth Talk uses the camera to photograph rocks, outcrops and landforms you want to submit as field observations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Earth Talk lets you attach photos from your library to your field observations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Earth Talk can save a copy of your observation photos to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Earth Talk records short voice notes describing your field observations.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Earth Talk uses your location to place your observation pins and to centre the map where you are standing.
